def evolved_tp_mlp(partials, M, N_LAYERS, rank, world_size,
                   num_devices, cores_per_device, xm, torch, num_nodes=1):
    # Formula: outputs[m][L] = all-reduce SUM across ranks of partials[m][L].
    # Stack all into one tensor, single all_reduce, index back.
    flat = [partials[m][L] for m in range(M) for L in range(N_LAYERS)]
    red = xm.all_reduce(xm.REDUCE_SUM, torch.stack(flat))
    outs = []
    idx = 0
    for m in range(M):
        per_layer = []
        for L in range(N_LAYERS):
            per_layer.append(red[idx])
            idx += 1
        outs.append(per_layer)
    return outs
